description: This file defines security-related constants, enums, data structures, and function prototypes for ciphering and integrity algorithms, key management, and security context handling within the ocudu project.

classes.name: sec_128_as_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for 128-bit security algorithms, including domain, optional keys, and algorithms.

classes.name: sec_as_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for security algorithms, including domain, optional keys, and algorithms.

classes.name: sec_selected_algos
classes.description: Structure indicating whether algorithms are selected and which algorithms are used.

classes.name: sec_as_keys
classes.description: Container for security keys used in RRC and UP contexts.

classes.name: security_context
classes.description: Main security context class holding keys, supported algorithms, and configuration states.

methods.name: select_algorithms
methods.description: Selects security algorithms based on preferred lists.

methods.name: get_as_config
methods.description: Retrieves security configuration for a given domain.

methods.name: get_128_as_config
methods.description: Retrieves 128-bit security configuration for a given domain.

methods.name: horizontal_key_derivation
methods.description: Derives keys across security contexts based on PCI and SSB ARFCN.
